components.title: Filter valid orders and deduplicate
components.what: Select shipped or pending orders, remove exact duplicate rows, and compute revenue as units times unit_price for each order.

components.title: Compute revenue per customer
components.what: Sum revenue by customer_id from the filtered deduplicated orders.

components.title: Find top customer and percentage
components.what: Identify the highest customer revenue, divide by total revenue, and express as a percentage to one decimal place.
